tagline: 格拉菲折叠相机，1947 年发布
description: The Graphic series are press cameras from Folmer & Schwing, later (after having been a division of Kodak for a handful of years) known as Folmer Graflex and then simply Graflexafter the very successful line of SLR's that made the company famous; all are folding bed cameras with a rack-focusing front
